measurement.title: Proton flux, illustrative specification
measurement.estimand: Differential proton flux Phi(R) at the top of the instrument, in m^-2 sr^-1 s^-1 GV^-1, per rigidity bin, for downward-going primary protons with rigidity above the geomagnetic cutoff criterion

data_scope.mc_scope: user-supplied MC production; generation record and version to be attached

selections.name: downward_primary
selections.definition: downward-going, tracker track present, rigidity above the cutoff criterion
selections.target_failure_mode: albedo and secondary particles at low rigidity
selections.conditional_denominator: events with a reconstructed tracker track

validation.metric: data/MC efficiency ratio in an orthogonal control sample, per rigidity bin
validation.threshold: deviation size that would move the flux by more than its total uncertainty, fixed in advance
validation.action: apply a scale factor with uncertainty; otherwise add a systematic

selections.name: charge_consistency
selections.definition: absolute charge consistent with one across the subsystems that measure it

validation.metric: efficiency in a loosened-selection control sample versus rigidity
validation.threshold: pre-declared tolerance from its effect on the flux
validation.action: add a rigidity-dependent systematic or change the estimator

backgrounds.name: helium_and_deuteron_contamination
backgrounds.origin: neighbouring charge or mass species entering the singly charged sample
backgrounds.entry_mechanism: charge migration and fragmentation upstream of the tracker
backgrounds.control_region: loosened charge-consistency sample that is depleted in signal
backgrounds.transfer_model: templates per rigidity bin carry over to the signal region; tested with alternate templates
backgrounds.contamination_correction: signal leakage into the control sample estimated from data and propagated
backgrounds.closure_test: inject a known contamination fraction and recover it

backgrounds.name: charge_confusion
backgrounds.origin: wrong charge-sign assignment from tracker resolution tails
backgrounds.entry_mechanism: tail migration of negative-sign particles into the positive sample
backgrounds.control_region: negative-sign sample with the same selection
backgrounds.transfer_model: tail probability measured on the control sample and applied per rigidity bin
backgrounds.contamination_correction: control sample purity from a template fit
backgrounds.closure_test: compare data and MC in a tail-populating loosened selection

systematics.name: rigidity_scale
systematics.variation_basis: bound from an independent reference measurement, user-supplied
systematics.validation: recompute the migration with the shifted scale and compare with linear propagation
double_counting_checks: calibration residual only; drift is not also counted as an efficiency effect

systematics.name: trigger_efficiency
systematics.variation_basis: statistical and method uncertainty of the unbiased-trigger sample
systematics.correlations_across_bins: partially correlated through the shared control sample
double_counting_checks: not also included in the data/MC scale factor

tail_estimates.name: charge_confusion
tail_estimates.tail_validation: tail region populated by a loosened selection; data and MC compared there

validation.name: mc_closure
validation.metric: unfolded minus truth over statistical error, per bin
validation.threshold: bound fixed before looking at data
validation.action: change the method or add a systematic

validation.name: distorted_spectrum
validation.metric: bias on a spectrum with a feature absent from the prior
validation.action: increase regularization study or use forward folding

parameters.name: geomagnetic cutoff safety factor
parameters.unit: x maximum cutoff in the field of view

parameters.name: data period of the cited proton analysis

ams_claims.text: A public AMS proton flux analysis required rigidity above 1.2 times the maximum geomagnetic cutoff and corrected bin-to-bin migration by iterative unfolding
ams_claims.label: Documented

ams_claims.text: Use a hybrid data/MC efficiency estimate with scale factors
ams_claims.label: Proposal
